source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    c.id AS ClienteIdSource,
    c.Nombre,
    c.Apellido,
    CONCAT(c.Nombre, ' ', c.Apellido) AS NombreCompleto,
    c.Cedula,
    c.Telefono,
    c.Correo,
    c.Direccion,
    d.Nombre AS Departamento,
    c.Estado AS EstadoCliente,
    c.FechaRegistro,
    c.HoraRegistro
FROM dbo.Clientes c
INNER JOIN dbo.departamentos d
    ON c.DepartamentoId = d.id;

SELECT
    s.id AS ServicioIdSource,
    s.Nombre_Servicio AS NombreServicio,
    s.Descripcion,
    CAST(s.Precio AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS PrecioLista,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), s.Duracion) AS Duracion
FROM dbo.Servicios s;

SELECT
    tc.id AS TipoContratoIdSource,
    tc.Nombre,
    tc.Descripcion
FROM dbo.TipoContrato tc;

SELECT
    ef.id AS EstadoFacturaIdSource,
    ef.estado AS Estado
FROM dbo.estado_factura ef;

SELECT
    u.id AS UsuarioIdSource,
    u.username AS Username,
    u.PrimerNombre,
    u.SegundoNombre,
    LTRIM(RTRIM(
        CONCAT(
            ISNULL(u.PrimerNombre, ''),
            ' ',
            ISNULL(u.SegundoNombre, '')
        )
    )) AS NombreCompleto,
    u.Rol,
    u.is_superuser AS IsSuperuser,
    u.is_staff AS IsStaff,
    u.is_active AS IsActive,
    u.FechaRegistro,
    u.HoraRegistro
FROM dbo.Usuarios u;

SELECT
    c.id AS ContratoIdSource,
    c.ClienteId AS ClienteIdSource,
    c.TipoContratoId AS TipoContratoIdSource,
    c.Fecha_Inc AS FechaInicio,
    c.Fecha_Fin AS FechaFin,
    c.EstadoContrato,
    c.Descripcion
FROM dbo.Contratos c;

scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT
    f.id AS FacturaIdSource,
    df.id AS DetalleFacturaIdSource,

    CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), f.Fecha_Emision, 112))
        AS FechaEmisionKey,

    CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), f.Fecha_Vencimiento, 112))
        AS FechaVencimientoKey,

    c.ClienteId AS ClienteIdSource,
    df.ServicioId AS ServicioIdSource,
    c.TipoContratoId AS TipoContratoIdSource,
    f.EstadoId AS EstadoFacturaIdSource,
    f.UsuarioId AS UsuarioIdSource,
    f.ContratoId AS ContratoIdSource,

    f.CodigoFact,
    df.Cantidad,
    CAST(df.PrecioVenta AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS PrecioVenta

FROM dbo.Detalle_Factura df
INNER JOIN dbo.Facturas f
    ON df.FacturaId = f.id

INNER JOIN dbo.Contratos c
    ON f.ContratoId = c.id',
